descriptions.cluster_uuid: Globally unique identifier for cross-referencing with IBL database via ONE API.
descriptions.cumulative_drift_um_per_hour: Sum of absolute depth changes between consecutive spikes, normalized to um/hour. Formula: sum(abs(diff(spike_depths)))/duration*3600. High values indicate either electrode drift or depth estimation noise. Scales with spike count (~0.79 correlation). NOT actual electrode displacement.
descriptions.distance_from_probe_tip_um: Mean distance from the probe tip in micrometers, computed from waveform center of mass. 0 = probe tip, values increase toward brain surface.
descriptions.electrodes: the electrodes that each spike unit came from
descriptions.ibl_quality_score: Proportion of IBL quality metrics passed (0.0, 0.33, 0.67, or 1.0). 1.0 = all three passed.
descriptions.isi_violations_ratio: Ratio of observed to expected ISI violations (Steinmetz/cortex-lab method). Can exceed 1.0. Equivalent to SpikeInterface's isi_violations_ratio.
descriptions.max_electrode: Index into the electrodes table for the electrode with maximum spike amplitude for this unit.
descriptions.median_spike_amplitude_uV: Median spike amplitude in microvolts. IBL uses 50 uV threshold for quality filtering.
descriptions.missed_spikes_estimate: Estimated fraction of spikes missed due to detection threshold (0.0-1.0).
descriptions.noise_cutoff: Standard deviations the lower amplitude quartile deviates from expected. Large values indicate missed spikes at detection threshold.
descriptions.peak_to_trough_duration_ms: Duration from negative trough to positive peak of the mean waveform in milliseconds. Used to distinguish fast-spiking interneurons (~0.2-0.4 ms) from regular-spiking pyramidal cells (~0.4-0.8+ ms).
descriptions.presence_ratio: Fraction of time bins (60s default) with at least one spike. Good units typically >0.9.
descriptions.presence_ratio_std: Standard deviation of spike counts across 10-second time bins.
descriptions.probe_name: Name of probe this unit was recorded from in canonical format (e.g., 'Probe00', 'Probe01').
descriptions.rp_violation: Contamination estimate using Hill et al. (2011) quadratic formula. Aligns with SpikeInterface's rp_violations.
descriptions.sliding_rp_violation: Binary pass/fail (0.0 or 1.0) using sliding refractory period algorithm. Primary metric for ibl_quality_score. Aligns with SpikeInterface's sliding_rp_violations.
descriptions.spike_amplitude_std_dB: Standard deviation of log-transformed spike amplitudes in decibels. High values (>6 dB) may indicate drift or contamination.
descriptions.spike_amplitudes_uV: Peak amplitude of each spike for each unit in microvolts.
descriptions.spike_count: Total number of spikes assigned to this unit. Integer type; -1 indicates missing data.
descriptions.spike_distances_from_probe_tip_um: Distance from the probe tip for each spike in micrometers, computed from waveform center of mass. 0 = probe tip, values increase toward brain surface.
descriptions.spike_times: the spike times for each unit in seconds
descriptions.waveform_mean: the spike waveform mean for each spike unit
